models.formula: spending × (1 + inflation)^elapsedYears; sum annual undiscounted cash needs. This is NOT present-value capital.

Restricted allocations grow at the explicitly declared net annual scenario rate before release; prior restricted growth is separate from current-year growth. Projection begins in the next complete calendar year after asOf; no retroactive current-year growth or contribution. End-period contribution after effective-period growth. Annual costs withdrawn at year end; unfunded costs recorded, never financed implicitly. Net annual factor=(1+return)×(1-fee).
